name: My Khe beachfront
kicker: Clubs and coffee on the My Khe sand
summary: Spend the evening on the sand, not in the lanes. Kalà Kalà at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap is free to enter, and its own site lists both midnight and 02:00 as closing. East West faces the water from 08:00 to 01:00, and that page does not print a street. A drink price is check on arrival.
fee: Kalà Kalà entry is free. A drink is check on arrival.
getThere: Walk from a My Khe hotel to 51 Vo Nguyen Giap for Kalà Kalà. East West’s street number is check on arrival.
heroCaption: People on the sand, with the headland in the haze

notice.title: Kalà Kalà prints two closing times
notice.body: The guest guide says 08:00 to 02:00. The same site’s footer says 08:00 to midnight. Entry is free either way. Confirm the night you go. East West is a separate door, 08:00 to 01:00, and its street is not on that page.

body: This is the beach evening: a club and a brewery on the sand, and a coffee when you want a chair facing the water. Kalà Kalà Beach Club is at 51 Vo Nguyen Giap. Its own site says entry is free, and it lists both 08:00 to midnight and 08:00 to 02:00. East West Brewing’s beachfront taproom, on My Khe, pours from 08:00 to 01:00 every day. That page says “by the shores of My Khe” and does not give a street number.
Neither page prints a drink price. Ask before you order. The lanes a few streets inland are An Thuong, which is the other night. The swim, the buoys, and the rescue clock are on the My Khe page.
The photograph is the beach with people in the water and no close tower line. It is not a picture of Kalà Kalà or of East West. No licensed photograph of either room was found.

figures.caption: The My Khe sand, with the resort line further along the beach
figures.alt: Surf and sand at My Khe, with resort towers along the left of the frame

gettingThere: From a hotel on My Khe, walk to Vo Nguyen Giap. Kalà Kalà is number 51. East West’s number is not published, so ask on the sand. From the river, take a Grab. The minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From a My Khe hotel
legs.body: Walk to 51 Vo Nguyen Giap for Kalà Kalà. East West is on the same beachfront, street number check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the river
legs.body: By Grab to Vo Nguyen Giap. The minutes are check on arrival.

hours: Kalà Kalà lists both 08:00 to midnight and 08:00 to 02:00. East West is 08:00 to 01:00 every day.
closed: No weekly closing day is published for either room.
